Uncrumpled Artwork brief · 18 August 2026
Paid social · static

Seven ad artworks to build

Each image below is a working mock, not a final file. Build each one properly at 1080 x 1350 for Meta feed, and supply a 1080 x 1080 crop of the same artwork where the layout allows it. Six are type and vector only. One needs a photograph.

Specs

  • 1080 x 1350 primary, RGB, PNG or JPG at high quality.
  • 1080 x 1080 secondary crop where the layout allows.
  • Keep the top and bottom 14 percent clear of anything critical so nothing is lost behind feed chrome.
  • Supply layered working files as well as flats.

Type and colour

  • Display serif is Fraunces. Body and UI sans is Inter. The tabloid headlines are Archivo Black. Handwriting on the sticky note is Caveat.
  • Australian English. No em dashes anywhere.
F5EFE2
FFFDF8
5C6E50
D8E88F
22201C

Rules

  • No Uncrumpled wordmark on the artwork. The bottle carries the brand, nothing else needs to.
  • No people in any frame.
  • Green is the only brand colour. No orange, no terracotta.
  • Set the copy exactly as written. Do not rewrite, shorten or re-punctuate it.
  • The bottle cut out will be supplied on transparent background. Never rebuild or retouch the label.
